name: Saint Barthélemy
prevalence_note: The prefecture for Saint-Barthélemy and Saint-Martin has issued a digital-fraud vigilance notice, and French national cyber-assistance guidance on fake parcel messages covers the island.
cross_border_note: Saint-Barthélemy shares +590 with Guadeloupe and Saint-Martin, and many residents and seasonal staff also receive calls from mainland France (+33) and US numbers.

scams.name: Faux avis de colis avec frais ou code
scams.name_en: Fake parcel notice asking for a fee, card or code on Saint-Barthélemy
scams.signals_en: A message styled as La Poste or a courier says a parcel is stuck and asks for small fees, card details or a code sent by text.
scams.legit_en: The prefecture urges residents to stay vigilant, and French cyber-assistance advises ignoring card or code requests in parcel messages.
bait_tactics: Demander lentement le nom de l'expéditeur et le port d'arrivée du colis
Dire que le colis sera vérifié directement au bureau de Gustavia
